`jgraph-flowchart.drawio` and `jgraph-swimlanes.drawio` are draw.io's own templates
`basic/flowchart.xml` and `basic/swimlanes.xml`, unmodified, from
[jgraph/drawio](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio) at tag `v32.5.5`
(`src/main/webapp/templates/`), © JGraph Ltd, under the
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
licence. They are files draw.io itself wrote — compressed pages included — which is why
they are here: the checker is tested against the real format, not only against XML this
repository wrote.
